data.gender_notes: Aliq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Aliq is derived from the root letters 'A-L-Q' which mean 'exalted' or 'sublime'. It is a name with deep spiritual significance, often given to boys in the Islamic community. The name Aliq carries the meaning “Exalted, Sublime” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aliq usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, sublime and live with faith, good character and purpose.
